errors.generic: Unable to complete the request. Try again.
errors.0: Could not connect to the API. Check that the service is running.
errors.400: Check your input. The source may have returned fields outside the accepted limits.
errors.401: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.403: Your account does not have permission for this action.
errors.404: This item was not found. Refresh the list.
errors.413: The submitted content exceeds the size limit.
errors.422: This source is unavailable. Check permissions and service configuration.
errors.429: Too many requests. Wait a moment before trying again.
errors.502: The source did not respond as expected. Try another link or try again later.
errors.503: The service is unavailable. Check the API and database configuration.
errors.504: Collection took longer than expected. Refresh the list before trying again.
errors.server: The service encountered an error. Try again later.
